Shared single-line input chrome with optional prefix/suffix adornments and a global cmd/ctrl keyboard shortcut. Consumers keep native input semantics while sharing the clicky border, focus ring, and density tokens.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/InputField.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { InputField } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/components";
```

## Demos

No dedicated Storybook demo is available for this component yet.

The props table documents the component-specific surface. Standard DOM attributes inherited from React, such as `className`, event handlers, and accessibility attributes, may also be accepted when the component's prop type extends a native element.
